Requirement_Text: The lighting module shall operate from 9.0 V to 16.0 V input without loss of commanded function.
Assumptions: Nominal 12 V vehicle supply; transient events excluded from this demo
Proposed_Test: Bench input voltage sweep at low/nominal/high values

Requirement_Text: Low beam output shall remain enabled when commanded ON and input voltage is within the normal operating range.
Assumptions: Optical performance values are not included in this demo
Proposed_Test: Command low beam ON across voltage cases and log output state

Requirement_Text: High beam output shall remain disabled unless the high beam command is active.
Proposed_Test: Command truth-table test for high beam enable/disable

Requirement_Text: The DRL mode shall command reduced current relative to full-intensity operation.
Assumptions: Reduction target is synthetic and must be configured per demo case
Proposed_Test: Compare commanded current in full and DRL modes

Requirement_Text: The tool shall flag any requirement that lacks a verification method.
Assumptions: Applies to portfolio tool output, not product design
Proposed_Test: Review generated trace matrix for blank verification fields

Requirement_Text: The output report shall separate assumptions from verified facts.
Assumptions: Facts in demo are generated synthetic values
Proposed_Test: Inspect report sections for assumption and fact separation

Requirement_Text: All public examples shall be labeled as synthetic demonstration data.
Proposed_Test: Check exported files for synthetic-data banner

Requirement_Text: Thermal review shall be required if estimated board temperature exceeds the configured demo threshold.
Assumptions: Threshold is synthetic and conservative for demo purposes
Proposed_Test: Run feasibility calculation and inspect risk flag

Requirement_Text: The trace matrix shall include requirement ID, subsystem, requirement type, verification method, risk, and review status.
Assumptions: Column names are defined by the source-pack schema

Requirement_Text: Ambiguous requirements shall be flagged before inclusion in a design-review packet.
Assumptions: Ambiguity scoring is proposed by AI and reviewed by engineer
Proposed_Test: Review ambiguity flag and reviewer disposition

Requirement_Text: The system shall record open questions generated during requirements review.
Assumptions: Questions are generated from synthetic text

Requirement_Text: AI-generated classifications shall remain draft until a qualified engineer reviews them.
Proposed_Test: Check review status field before publish/export
